title: Qwen3.6-27B INT8 KV scope and temporal BF16-tail screen

runtime_scope.blocker: ValueError: Qwen3.5 INT8 GQA split-K specialization requires block_size=256, num_q_heads=16, num_kv_heads=2, head_dim=256
runtime_scope.interpretation: The generic policy and writer can allocate/write 27B INT8 KV, but the registered c1 direct-INT8 decode consumer is specialized to the 35B 16Q/2KV geometry. Qwen3.6-27B pure INT8 and any temporal mixed derivative are not currently runnable native routes.

paro.allocation: one reusable layer-local BF16 K/V workspace across full-attention layers
paro.memory_pressure_fallback: existing direct-streaming INT8 prefill; measured historically far slower

gguf.allocation: one full-length BF16 K/V oracle pair per INT8-retained full-attention layer for chunk-outer prefill; all survive until prefill exits
gguf.interpretation: The implementation behavior is generic, but byte cost follows each model's KV geometry and number of INT8-retained full-attention layers. The 35B prefix-eight qualification does not transfer to 27B.

host_emulation.kind: same-weight BF16-cache roundtrip screen; not native split attention

format.history: per-token/per-head symmetric INT8 K/V with FP16 scales, reconstructed into BF16
format.demotion: current row remains BF16 for its attention and is quantized when it leaves the recent window

host_emulation.decision: Do not implement a temporal tail from this screen. Both tails pass this single prompt, but pure emulated INT8 is numerically better and cheaper. Host reconstruction cannot validate the missing native 24Q/4KV consumer or split-attention arithmetic.

lowest_risk_sequence: Add and CPU-oracle-gate a native per-token/head INT8 split-K decode specialization for 24 query heads, 4 KV heads, head_dim 256, block size 256; retain the current 16/2 specialization as fallback for its admitted geometry.
Run native pure INT8 at 512/8 and complete 4K/16 category/train/heldout plus mixed_v1 with no BF16 mirror and all 16 full-attention layers audited as INT8.

Only if pure native INT8 fails, screen layer-local BF16 retention first because current policy/allocation already supports per-layer storage. Do not inherit the 35B prefix-eight policy without 27B quality and memory gates.

Consider a temporal tail only after it materially beats pure INT8 across the full prompt suite. A native temporal route requires two disjoint K/V arenas per layer, position-aware split attention with stable softmax merge, row demotion as tokens age, complete KVLiveSpans transaction/copy/rollback support, and new no-shadow/capacity gates.
product_decision: BF16 KV remains the only supported Qwen3.6-27B GGUF route. Current 27B INT8 KV has no quality verdict because native decode is unsupported; temporal BF16 tail remains a rejected-for-now design candidate, not an implementation or user-facing mode.
